title: 第12章  能舔吗？
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
回到别墅，姜知夏已经困得眼皮打架。
陆决摸索着从走廊里走出来，“公主……”
“你怎么还没睡？”她看了眼时间，已经快凌晨两点了。
陆决没说话。
她把蛋糕提起来晃了晃，“看，这是答应给你带的好吃的，不过今天太晚了，明天再吃。”
陆决闻到了甜腻的味道，沉默着点头。
公主……是真的没把他当奴隶啊。
姜知夏把蛋糕放进全智能冰箱，牵起他的手，“走吧，你回房间休息，我也累死了。”
陆决乖乖被她牵着走。
他亦步亦趋跟在身后，偷偷嗅着她身上那股好闻的香气。
好像越来越浓了，但是为什么……混杂着一股陌生雄性的味道？
姜知夏把人领到房门口，自从上次易感期事件后，她就给陆决单独收拾出了一间房。
“进去吧，早点睡。”她松开手。
陆决站在门口，看着她转身离开，微微皱起眉。
同一时间，苏家。
苏尘刚进门，迎面就甩来一巴掌。
“啪——！”
同样的位置，不同的力道。
打得他眼前发黑，嘴里瞬间尝到血腥味。
他缓缓抬起头，看向眼前趾高气昂，面容精致的少年。

苏明旭，他同母异父的弟弟。
苏明旭抱着手臂，仰着下巴看他，“总算回来了，今天有没有成功勾引到公主？”
苏尘低着头，没说话。
明明以前也经历过不少这样的巴掌，甚至比这更有羞辱意味的事情，可偏偏今天，他得到了真诚的道歉。
这让他突然从心底生出了一股怒意。
苏明旭看着他握紧的拳头，冷笑一声，“呵，胆子大了，问话都敢不答？”
说着，他抬手又要扇下来。
手腕在半空中被攥住了。
苏明旭愕然，看向苏尘。
这个一向温顺、从不反抗的哥哥，此刻抬起了头。
“我不能挨打。”
苏明旭用力抽回手，嗤笑：“呵，参加个宴会就觉得自己金贵了？怎么不能？”
苏尘看着他，“公主答应选我做正夫了。”
“三天后皇宫会公布，她会选我。”
苏明旭的表情僵住了。
他上下打量他，眼神怀疑：“你有什么证据？别是回来随便扯谎的。”
苏尘抹去嘴角的血迹，淡淡道：“前段时间，白知遇到处宣言公主会送他一颗共鸣水晶做生日礼物，你应该听说过。”
他掏出水晶，举到苏明旭眼前，“她送给了我。”
苏明旭看着水晶，表情复杂了起来。
竟然真让他勾引到了？

那个三公主，果然是个彻头彻尾的花痴，以前追着白知遇跑，现在说不准也会追着苏尘跑。
那确实不能随便打了，身上带了伤可不好和皇室交代。
“行吧，”苏明旭撇了撇嘴，浑不在意地哼了一声，可眼神却充斥着恶意，“你应该庆幸你这张脸用上了，不然……我一定给你毁了。”
他转身离开。
苏尘站在原地，捏紧手里的水晶。
他抬起手，用指尖碰了碰红肿的脸。
是啊，幸亏这张脸有用。
姜知夏一觉睡到自然醒。
阳光洒进来暖洋洋的，她在柔软的被子里滚了两圈才爬起来。
拉着陆决简单吃过早饭后，盯着他吃药。
把几颗胶囊和药丸配好，放在陆决手心里，“这个药长期吃可以疏通精神力，每天早晚各一次，抑制剂只能在易感期用，平时不能用，
陆决点头，乖乖把药放进嘴里吞下去。
姜知夏看得眉毛一拧。
那药很苦的，她刚才闻着味儿都觉得很苦，他就这么面不改色吞了？
她转身去冰箱里拿出昨天带回来的小蛋糕，“快吃点这个，去去苦味。”
因为陆决看不清，平时吃饭要么手抓，要么用大勺子，可蛋糕这么精细的东西得用刀叉，让他自己吃，会弄得一团糟。
姜知夏干脆自己动手喂，用叉子叉起来递到他嘴边：“张嘴。”
陆决乖乖张开嘴。
奶油的甜香在口腔里化开，盖过了药的苦味。
“好吃吗？”

“好吃。”
姜知夏笑了，又切了一块喂他。
就这样一口一口，到最后一块，上面的奶油堆得太高，颤颤巍巍地掉了。
姜知夏下意识伸手抓住，呼了一手奶油。
“啊呀，可惜了，这块奶油最厚，底下还有果酱呢……”
她刚想去洗手，手腕突然被握住了。
“公主，能舔吗？”
姜知夏愣住：啊？什么？
就这么一下的功夫，陆决已经低下头。
舌尖从她的手腕内侧舔过，裹着那坨奶油推向掌心，顺着纹路舔到指尖。
姜知夏整个人僵在原地，一动不敢动。
……其实挺不卫生的。
孩子不浪费粮食是好事，就是……是不是太暧昧了点？
陆决舔得很认真，把五根纤细的手指一根一根舔过去，把奶油和果酱都卷进嘴里。
他抬起头，一脸乖相。
姜知夏迅速把手抽回来，清了清嗓子：“嗯……好了，还想吃吗？”
“不用了，谢谢公主。”
味道舔干净了。
姜知夏脸上莫名发烫，看着自己湿漉漉的手，叹了口气。
这眼睛……到底什么时候才能好啊？

就这么过了三天，终于到了姜知夏想躲都躲不了的事。
雌后让她回皇宫选正夫。
她收到消息，愁得抱头。
万万没想到，选正夫，是要像选秀一样站成一排的那种选！
那多尴尬！
权力啊，果然是个好东西，即使她是个废雌，竞选的人也不少。
但这事躲不了，因为她还答应了苏尘一件事。
那天苏尘跪在地上请求她，只是暂时选定，三个月后，他会自己主动解除这层关系。
她猜测是和皇室与贵族之间的建交有关，想着反正要是选了别人做正夫也很麻烦，就答应了。
所以这一趟，她不去也不行。
姜霆神色漠然地看着光屏。
能入选的，基本都是一等贵族。
以三大贵族为首，往下八个一等贵族中参与竞选的嫡系雄性资料都在这儿。
三天前，雌后让他协助挑选，他还完全没放在心上。
姜知夏精神力低弱，能有个贵族雄性缔结契约，是为她未来做保障，左右选个差不多养得起她的就可以。
可是现在……
他面无表情地看着这些人的资料。
狐族宁家是疯了吗？推一个B级嫡系，要是没记错，去年这人才因为酗酒行凶被警告过。
其他的，更离谱。
要么是嫡系中精神力差的，要么是种族有缺陷的，甚至还有人胆大包天，把生父是侍奴，侧夫的雄性塞进来。

一看就是特地敷衍，不想把真正优秀的嫡系送进来浪费。
姜霆缓慢吸了一口气，漆黑的眼眸掠过杀意。
这些贵族，太放肆了。
他也不知道自己在不满什么。
其实按照以前的想法，选个家世尚可，等级不高不低，也可以配姜知夏。
但有了那天犯下的错误，他再看这些雄性，没一个看得上眼。
姜霆关掉光脑，屏幕上所有雄性的脸瞬间消失。
一群废物，有什么好选的。
content_en:
Back at the villa, Jiang Zhixia was so sleepy that her eyelids were twitching.
Lu Jue groped his way out of the corridor, "Princess..."
"Why aren't you asleep yet?" She looked at the time, it was almost two o'clock in the morning.
Lu Jue said nothing.
She lifted the cake and shook it, "Look, this is the delicious food I promised you, but it's too late today. We'll eat it tomorrow."
Lu Jue smelled the sweet smell and nodded silently.
The princess... really didn't treat him as a slave.
Jiang Zhixia put the cake in the smart refrigerator and held his hand, "Let's go back to your room to rest. I'm exhausted too."
Lu Jue was led by her obediently.
He followed her step by step, secretly smelling the delicious fragrance on her body.
It seems to be getting stronger and stronger, but why... is it mixed with the smell of a strange male?
Jiang Zhixia led people to the door of the room. Since the last susceptible period incident, she had tidied up a room for Lu Jue alone.
"Go in and go to bed early." She let go.
Lu Jue stood at the door, frowning slightly as he watched her turn and leave.
At the same time, the Su family.
As soon as Su Chen entered the door, he was slapped in the face.
"Crack-!"
Same position, different strength.
The beating made his eyes black, and he instantly tasted blood in his mouth.
He slowly raised his head and looked at the arrogant young man in front of him with an exquisite face.
Su Mingxu, his half-brother.
Su Mingxu crossed his arms and looked at him with his chin raised, "I'm finally back. Did you successfully seduce the princess today?"
Su Chen lowered his head and said nothing.
He had obviously experienced many such slaps before, even more humiliating things than this, but today, he received a sincere apology.
This made him suddenly feel angry from the bottom of his heart.
Su Mingxu looked at his clenched fists and sneered, "Haha, how dare you not even answer questions?"
As he spoke, he raised his hand to fan it down again.
His wrist was caught in mid-air.
Su Mingxu was stunned and looked at Su Chen.
This brother, who had always been docile and never resisted, now raised his head.
"I can't take a beating."
Su Mingxu withdrew his hand forcefully and sneered: "Ha, you feel rich after attending a banquet? Why not?"
Su Chen looked at him and said, "The princess agreed to choose me as her husband."
"The palace will announce in three days that she will choose me."
Su Mingxu's expression froze.
He looked him up and down with doubtful eyes: "What evidence do you have? Don't just come back and lie casually."
Su Chen wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and said calmly: "Some time ago, Bai Zhi met Chu and announced that the princess would give him a resonance crystal as a birthday gift. You should have heard about it."
He took out the crystal and held it up to Su Mingxu's eyes, "She gave it to me."
Su Mingxu looked at the crystal with a complicated expression.
Did he actually seduce him?
The third princess is indeed a complete nymphomaniac. She used to chase Bai Zhiyu, but now she might chase Su Chen.
You really can't hit him casually. It's hard to explain to the royal family if you're injured.
"Okay," Su Mingxu curled his lips and snorted nonchalantly, but his eyes were full of malice, "You should be lucky that you used this face, otherwise... I will definitely ruin it for you."
He turned and left.
Su Chen stood there and squeezed the crystal in his hand.
He raised his hand and touched his red and swollen face with his fingertips.
Yeah, luckily this face works.
Jiang Zhixia slept until she woke up naturally.
The sun was shining warmly, and she rolled twice in the soft quilt before getting up.
After pulling Lu Jue to have a simple breakfast, she watched him take medicine.
He mixed several capsules and pills and placed them in Lu Jue's hand. "This medicine can be taken for a long time to clear up the mental energy. Take it once every morning and evening. The inhibitor can only be used during the susceptible period and cannot be used at ordinary times.
Lu Jue nodded, put the medicine into his mouth and swallowed it obediently.
Jiang Zhixia frowned.
That medicine is very bitter. She justThe smell was very bitter, so he just swallowed it without changing his expression?
She turned around and went to the refrigerator to take out the small cake she brought back yesterday, "Eat this quickly to get rid of the bitter taste."
Because Lu Jue couldn't see clearly, he usually had to eat with his hands or use a big spoon, but for something as delicate as a cake, he had to use a knife and fork. If he was allowed to eat it by himself, it would make a mess.
Jiang Zhixia simply fed it herself, picked it up with a fork and handed it to his mouth: "Open your mouth."
Lu Jue obediently opened his mouth.
The sweet fragrance of the cream melted in the mouth, overpowering the bitter taste of the medicine.
"Is it delicious?"
“Delicious.”
Jiang Zhixia smiled and cut another piece to feed him.
Just like this, one bite at a time, until the last piece, the cream on top was piled too high and fell off tremblingly.
Jiang Zhixia subconsciously reached out to grab it and breathed out a handful of cream.
"Ah, what a pity, this cream is the thickest, and there is jam underneath..."
She was about to wash her hands when her wrist was suddenly held.
"Princess, can you lick it?"
Jiang Zhixia was stunned: Huh? What?
In just a moment, Lu Jue lowered his head.
The tip of his tongue licked from the inside of her wrist, wrapped in the cream and pushed it to her palm, licking along the lines to her fingertips.
Jiang Zhixia froze in place, not daring to move.
...It's actually quite unhygienic.
It's a good thing that children don't waste food, but... isn't it a bit too ambiguous?
Lu Jue licked very seriously, licking the five slender fingers one by one, and rolled all the cream and jam into his mouth.
He raised his head with a good look on his face.
Jiang Zhixia quickly pulled her hand back and cleared her throat: "Well... okay, do you still want to eat?"
"No, thank you princess."
The taste licked clean.
Jiang Zhixia's face felt inexplicably hot. She looked at her wet hands and sighed.
These eyes...when will they heal?
Three days passed like this, and finally something happened that Jiang Zhixia couldn't avoid even if he wanted to.
The female queen asked her to go back to the palace to choose a real husband.
When she received the news, she was so worried that she held her head.
I never imagined that choosing a real husband would be like standing in a row at a draft!
How embarrassing!
Power is indeed a good thing. Even if she is a waste woman, there are many people running for it.
But this matter cannot be avoided, because she also promised Su Chen something.
That day, Su Chen knelt on the ground and begged her. He only made a temporary decision. After three months, he would take the initiative to terminate this relationship.
She guessed that it had something to do with the establishment of diplomatic relations between the royal family and the nobility. She thought it would be troublesome to choose someone else to be her husband anyway, so she agreed.
So this trip, it would be okay if she didn't go.
Jiang Ting looked at the light screen with an indifferent expression.
Those who can be selected are basically first-class nobles.
Headed by the three major nobles, the information on the male direct lineage participating in the election for the next eight first-class nobles is here.
Three days ago, the queen asked him to help with the selection, but he didn't take it to heart at all.
Jiang Zhixia has weak mental strength, so being able to sign a contract with an aristocratic male is to ensure her future, so she can just choose someone who can almost afford to support her.
But now...
He looked at these people's information with a blank expression.
Are the Ning family of the fox clan crazy? I recommend a B-level direct descendant. If I remember correctly, this person was warned last year for drunkenness and violence.
Others are even more outrageous.
Either those in the direct lineage are mentally weak, or they are racially defective, and some are even bold enough to bring in males whose biological fathers are servants and side husbands.
At first glance, it seems that it is deliberately perfunctory and does not want to waste the truly outstanding direct descendants.
Jiang Ting took a slow breath, his dark eyes flashing with murderous intent.
These nobles are too presumptuous.
He didn't know what he was dissatisfied with.
In fact, according to the previous thinking, it is okay to choose a family background, a level that is not high or low, and it can also be matched with Jiang Zhixia.
But after the mistake he made that day, when he looked at these males, he couldn't look at any of them.
Jiang Ting turned off the optical brain, and all the male faces on the screen disappeared instantly.
A bunch of trash,What's there to choose from?
